name: pileup
description: One row per codon covered by an eligible peptide, with REF, I/L and ALT distinct-peptide counts (GIPPA_SPEC.md §7.5.2, §7.5.5, §9.3).

fields.name: codon_start
fields.description: Lowest coordinate of the codon, 1-based, within [1, length]

fields.name: strand
fields.description: Strand of the peptides' reading frame

fields.name: gene
fields.description: Locus tag of the same-strand gene framing the codon (smallest tag if several)

fields.name: aa_pos
fields.description: 1-based residue position of the codon in the gene

fields.name: ref_aa
fields.description: Table-11 reference residue of the codon on the strand

fields.name: n_ref
fields.description: Distinct peptides (I/L folded) reading the reference residue

fields.name: n_il
fields.description: Distinct peptides reading I or L at an I/L codon (ambiguous)

fields.name: alt_counts
fields.description: Semicolon-joined ALT keys with their distinct-peptide counts (X:n;Y:m), most supported first
